params.name: folder
params.label: Select Image Folder
params.tooltip: All images in subfolders will be processed recursively.

params.name: output_root
params.label: Output Root Folder (optional)
params.tooltip: If set, output will preserve folder structure under this root. If not, '_tiny_imgs' subfolders will be created inside each source folder.

params.name: target_size
params.label: Target Size (KB)
params.tooltip: Desired output file size in kilobytes.

params.name: output_format
params.label: Output Format
params.tooltip: Convert all images to this format.
